description: Defines the implementation of a metrics collector class for Ethernet transmitter metrics, including methods for collecting, updating, and resetting statistical data related to Ethernet transmission performance.

classes.name: transmitter_metrics_collector_impl
classes.description: Implementation of a metrics collector for Ethernet transmitter, providing methods to collect, update, and reset transmission metrics.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Collects current transmission metrics and resets internal counters.

methods.name: disabled
methods.description: Checks if the metrics collector is disabled.

methods.name: create_time_execution_measurer
methods.description: Creates a time execution measurer object.

methods.name: update_stats
methods.description: Updates internal statistics with new transmission data.
